text:
# listing.warranty

TL;DR:
- listing.warranty expresses the warranty mode of the listing, and custom needs extra care.

What it means:
- It is a normalized marketplace warranty signal when available.
- custom means the listing has warranty semantics that are not fully captured by the standard buckets.

Agent hint:
- If the value is custom, explain that more listing detail may be needed instead of inventing exact warranty terms.
